description: Start audience-demand research for the supplied anchor, market and language. Creates a research lineage and queues a collection run, which may consume credits and provider costs. First call socialseal_explore_preview_start; use its planFingerprint as previewFingerprint with the same scope, explicit workspace and retry key. Returns lineage/run identifiers and execution state; inspect the run for results. If the server requests scope confirmation, supply confirmedScopeFingerprint only after the user confirms that scope, reusing the same idempotencyKey.

confirmedScopeFingerprint.description: Required only when the start preview or a rejected start returned confirmationRequired; echo the reviewed planFingerprint once after the principal confirms the aggregate scope.
